sources.verified_angle_summary: At LEAP 2026, the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE), represented by its Secretary-General Musaed bin Abdullah Al-Otaibi, officially launched the "Mu'tamad" platform. This integrated digital ecosystem is designed to organize and develop engineering and construction transactions in Saudi Arabia. The platform will initially be rolled out in Jeddah before expanding kingdom-wide. It aims to govern over 200,000 engineering and construction transactions and connect more than 4,000 service providers. Key features include service provider search, contract management, quote comparison, and digital verification against over 4,000 design requirements based on the Saudi Building Code. The initiative is expected to achieve operational savings exceeding 14 million riyals. This launch represents a significant digital transformation step for the Saudi engineering sector, focusing on compliance, transparency, and market efficiency. The story is highly material as it involves a major national regulatory body launching a nationwide platform with specific adoption targets and financial impacts. It does not duplicate any existing coverage in the provided files.
